question: What is the compound interest for 1 year on a sum of Rs. 7000 at the annual rate of 36 percent compounding half yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 7000

Annual Interest Rate (R) = 36%

Time (T) = 1 year

Compounding Period = Half-Yearly

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P (1 + R/n)ⁿt - P

Where:

P = Principal Amount

R = Annual Interest Rate (in decimal)

n = Number of times interest i
